title: 'As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill' Season 3's New Video Announces More Cast
content:
The staff for the third television anime season based on Miraijin A 's As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ( Tensei Kizoku Kantei Sukiru de Nariagaru - Jakushō Ryōchi o Uketsuidanode, Yūshūna Jinzai o Fuyashite Itara, Saikyō Ryōchi ni Natteta ) light novel series announced three new cast members, along with the fourth promotional video, on Sunday. The "Assassin" arc started in episode 33 on Sunday.

Anna Nagase plays Enan Lugez, a mute girl who volunteered for military service at Canarre Castle.

Kōsuke Toriumi plays Virge Sammado, a young former noble whom Ars encounters in Samkh, claiming to be his distant relative.

Ayumu Murase plays Keefe Venge, a boy with extremely high skill caps in every stat.

Previously announced new cast members are Sumire Morohoshi as Musia Trick, Hinata Tadokoro as Zaht Brouzdo, Toshiya Miyata as Rikuya Fujimiya, Mariya Ise as Maika Fujimiya, and Takaki Ōtomari as Takao Fujimiya.

Takao Kato ( To Love-Ru , Zoids ) returns to direct the third season at new studio GeyeG Pictures . Daisuke Ōhigashi , who wrote episode scripts for the previous seasons, is now overseeing the series scripts, replacing Yasuhiro Nakanishi . Yūko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is also back to design the characters, and Kujira Yumemi ( In the Land of Leadale ) returns to compose the music.

Rico Sasaki performs the season's opening theme song "Still Water," while Akuruyo no Hitsuji performs the ending theme song "Hibi o Koete."

The third anime season premiered on CBC , TBS , and 26 other stations on September 27; on BS NTV on September 29; and on AT-X on October 1. The anime began streaming on U-NEXT , d Anime Store , and Anime Hōdai on September 28, and then on other streaming sites on October 1. Crunchyroll streams the season as it airs.

Kodansha USA Publishing has licensed Natsumi Inoue 's manga adaptation and light novel series (under its Vertical imprint). The company describes the story:

One day when leaving work, Ars Louvent dies and is reborn as a weak aristocrat in another world. Using his “Appraisal” skill, which lets him see the stats of others, he recruits the best people to his side in order to turn his country's fortunes around. Based on a hit light novel with over 30 million online views in Japan!

The first anime season premiered in April 2024 as the debut series for the new "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks.

The second season premiered in Japan in September 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The light novel series debuted in October 2019 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website. Kodansha publishes the light novel series with illustrations by jimmy. The manga adaptation launched in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket in June 2020.

title: Sakamoto Days Manga Ends
content:
This year's 52nd issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump published the final chapter of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga on Monday. Shueisha will publish the manga's 30th compiled book volume on January 4, 2027, followed by the 31st and final volume on April 30.

The manga announced in July that it is heading to its climax. The manga had started its "final battle" in August 2025. The series reached 18 million copies in circulation worldwide in August.

The current Weekly Shonen Jump issue also announced a new series titled Tonari no Tenis-bu no Kimi to (You, in the Neighboring Tennis Club, and I) will begin in the next issue.

Suzuki published a one-shot titled "Sakamoto" in Shueisha 's Jump Giga magazine in December 2019, and then launched the main manga in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in November 2020.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are publishing the manga in English digitally. MANGA Plus describes the manga:

Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villains and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! the chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

Viz Media is also publishing the manga in print.

The manga's spinoff titled Sakamoto Holidays launched in Shueisha 's Saikyō Jump magazine in July 2024. Tetsu Ōkawa , who works as an assistant on the main manga, is drawing the spinoff. Ōkawa reported earlier in November that Sakamoto Holidays is reaching its climax.

The main manga inspired a novel in April 2023, and a second novel shipped in December 2024.

The anime adaptation premiered on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels on January 11, 2025, and the series also debuted on Netflix on that day. The first season's second part premiered on July 14 on TV Tokyo and affiliated channels at 24:00 JST (effectively, July 15 at 12 midnight). The second part's first episode streamed in advance on Netflix on July 14, and only the 12th episode streamed simultaneously with the Japanese TV broadcast.

The second television anime season will premiere on January 18.

The manga also inspired a live-action film that opened on April 29. Yūichi Fukuda (live-action Gintama , Under Ninja ) directed and wrote the script for the film. The film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 346,000 tickets and earned 478 million yen (about US$3.05 million) in its first three days. In its first eight days in the Japanese box office, which spanned the entirety of the Golden Week holidays, the film sold 1.14 million tickets and earned 1.5 billion yen (about US$9.58 million).

title: Dragon Ball Needs to Retcon One of Its Weirdest Android 18 Choices
content:
The story of Dragon Ball is known for being goofy and off-beat beyond the battlefield. For all its serious moments, the story features characters with food names, an afterlife where bad guys are tortured by fairies and Mr. Satan changing to Hercule in the English dub and more amongst other numerous funny bits . One weird bit that should’ve received another edit before making the final cut, however, is Android 17 and 18’s name choice.

Android 17 and 18 are introduced as killing machines in Dragon Ball Z . They were kidnapped and created by the Red Ribbon Army’s Dr. Gero to kill Goku and take over the world. Their almost emotionless violence and super-powered abilities gave them a robot feel. Once Cell is defeated, the human part of them is restored, but their human names are not. It was revealed later by franchise creator Akira Toriyama that their names are Lapis (17) and Lazuli (18 ), however they were never brought into the manga or anime.

Android 18 Stays In Main Story With Old Name

Android 17 becomes a park ranger after the events of the Cell Saga and falls off the radar. Even though this point applies to him too and he deserves to have his name be something other than a number, the plot doesn’t awkwardly point it out time after time. Android 18 on the other hand marries Krillin, gives birth to Marron and becomes a member of the Z Fighters. And yet, her name stays simply, “18.” Anytime Krillin addresses her it’s that same number. An unceremonious way to address one of the anime’s fan favorite characters .

Plot-wise it makes sense to change it. The androids went from humans to bio-mechanical beings, so the number applies and fits their evil personas. Once they’ve transformed back to being normal people, however, a human name makes more sense for a “new-ish” beginning to their lives. The scene from Dragon Ball Super where Future Trunks sees her for the first time since their fight would still have the same terror and humor when he sees her as he associates the name Android 18 with something evil.

Lazuli is much more disarming, and would have changed that interaction overall. Then again, would you expect any less focus toward mid-card characters ? They’re regularly forgotten in the series.

Their Focus in Dragon Ball Super Only Made Their Names Even More Questionable

The awkwardness is only further focused in on when you remember that the Android twins were featured much more in Dragon Ball Super, especially towards the end. It’s one of the flaws of creating such an expansive universe as some characters are bound to be sidelined for a certain amount of time. The only way to get more information on those characters is either to have a whole side arc or series about a particular individual.

In Dragon Ball Super , fans got to see the pure hearts of Android 17 and 18. They battled for their home universe valiantly, and 17 got the wish for winning the Tournament of Power. He could’ve chosen whatever he wanted, even though it was expected he’d ask for something selflessly. He wished back all the erased universes, and it’s an action that a former robot (and someone with “Android” in their name) would never do.

Do you think the Android twins should get their real names brought into the official Dragon Ball canon? Let us know in the comments.

title: 5 Most Powerful One Piece Characters Luffy’s Gear 5 Can’t Defeat
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! Ever since the One Piece manga began serialization in 1997, Luffy has steadily grown more powerful. His journey has brought him several challenges, and there’s no denying he grew more powerful each time he overcame an obstacle. Of course, there were times like the Sabaody Archipelago and the Marineford Arc where he just couldn’t win, no matter how hard he tried. However, even those experiences shaped him to be the person he is today. Throughout the years, he transforms from a no-name rookie pirate into one of the Four Emperors of the Sea. This only happened because of his Gear 5 transformation, something he was only able to achieve after his Devil Fruit awakening.

It’s easily one of the best-written Shonen transformations of all time since it not only gives Luffy a huge power-up, but it also has centuries and maybe even millennia of history behind it. There’s no doubt Luffy is now one of the most powerful characters in the series, and he can easily take down almost everyone who crosses his path. However, because of his drawback, he is unable to make full use of his abilities. Now that the manga is in its Elbaph Arc, he is undergoing another mysterious transformation that could mean a huge power-up. However, as of now, it’s unlikely he will be able to defeat these five characters.

5) Marshall D. Teach

Even as one of the most important characters in the series, much about Blackbeard is still a mystery . While the Elbaph Arc delved into his origins, his powers haven’t been fully revealed yet. The series has yet to explain the reason he is able to possess the power of two Devil Fruits. Not only does he have two unimaginably powerful Devil Fruits at his disposal, but he is also an exceptionally skilled Haki user. Blackbeard is not only strong but also crafty, who would resort to any means necessary to accomplish his goals.

He is also someone Shanks considers a major threat, which makes him all the more dangerous. There’s still no guarantee which of the two is stronger in terms of raw power, but it’s evident that if they were to fight, Luffy would have a huge disadvantage at his current level. This is simply because his chances of winning would be considerably slim if he runs out of stamina and needs a break to eat food and replenish his energy.

4) Loki

Loki was introduced in the Elbaph Arc , and the series didn’t waste any time before confirming he is already a top-tier character. As Harald’s son who has the blood of the Ancient Giants running through his veins, Loki was already multiple times stronger than any average Giant. However, thanks to the legendary Devil Fruit and Ragnir, Loki is on a completely different level. His Devil Fruit allows the user to transform into the largest dragon in the world, but the size depends on the one who consumes it.

This is why the fruit’s true potential can only be achieved by an ancient Giant like Loki who was chosen by Ragnir to possess the power of this fruit. The ancient legend describes the mythical dragon as a being so vast that it envelops the sky with darkness and breathes lightning. As the fight continues in the manga, Loki even fought Imu one-on-one, something not everyone is capable of. It turned out well that Loki is actually an ally of Luffy, since he needs more powerful fighters on his side in the long run.

3) Dracule Mihawk

Mihawk is another one of those characters who mostly remains a mystery even after almost 30 years since the story began. Even though the true extent of his powers is unknown and he has absolutely no feats to speak of, his title alone is enough for him to rank in this list. Mihawk is not only the first Warlord introduced in the story, but he is someone Zoro must surpass before he can become the world’s strongest swordsman.

From his sword skills to how powerful his Haki is, fans have long been curious about everything related to this character. He and Shanks used to be rivals, and they were considered equals in power. Even the Final Saga has yet to shed more light on the character and his abilities. There hasn’t been any opportunity for him to showcase his true power, but that might change in the Final War that will envelop the entire world in flames.

2) Shanks

Shanks is not only one of the most crucial characters in the story, but his powers are overwhelming , even against characters like the Admirals and other Emperors of the Sea. He is Luffy’s role model who spent one year in his village and helped him set out on the path to becoming a pirate. Shanks is not only a swordsman, but his Haki is second to none. No other character has demonstrated a more powerful Conqueror’s Haki than he did at the end of the Wano Country Saga, where he intimidated Admiral Green Bull from miles away.

Fans have always known how powerful he is, but after that display, it really raises the question if any other character other than Imu can best him in raw power. While Luffy’s Haki and abilities aren’t something to scoff at, the young pirate hasn’t displayed a power strong enough to overwhelm Shanks, who earned his nickname of Haki Killer since he is the only character known to temporarily block someone’s future sight.

1) Imu

Imu finally made his true debut in the Elbaph Arc , and he is more powerful than fans realize. While there have been debates about the final antagonist before, his feats in the Elbaph Arc leave no room for doubt that Imu is the greatest obstacle standing in Luffy’s way. Luffy used his Gear 5 abilities in the Elbaph Arc, and the villain effortlessly defeated the young pirate. Having seen Joyboy’s true powers, Imu knows better than anyone that Luffy is nowhere near as powerful as he should be.

Aside from his immortality, what truly makes Imu terrifying is his demonic powers and the weapons he possesses from the First Twenty, the rulers of the Allied Nations during the time of the World Government’s establishment. Imu is by no means an ordinary fighter, since his powers are akin to a mythical God or maybe a demon. Since the fight in Elbaph is still ongoing, there’s always a chance we might see more of this villain’s true powers.

Which of these One Piece characters do you think poses the biggest challenge for Luffy? Is there anyone else he cannot defeat at his current level? Let us know in the comments below!

title: A Classic Romance Anime Returns With Special Makeover After 15 Years
content:
It’s always a special treat for fans to see their favorite anime series get revitalized years after the finale airs, whether it be a special pop-up that gives fans the opportunity to pick up new merchandise featuring their favorite characters, or, though rare, a brand-new season that revitalizes the fandom in full force. One such series, a cult-classic romance titled Inu x Boku SS , recently celebrated a major milestone and delivered by giving fans a stunning new illustration showcasing all of the main cast in commemorative outfits. The anime adaptation of Cocoa Fujiwara’s original manga is officially celebrating its 15th anniversary by revamping the franchise’s official website with new artwork from the series’ character designer and chief animation director, Haruko Iizuka.

Inu x Boku SS was produced by David Productions, based on the original manga by Cocoa Fujiwara published in Square Enix’s Gangan Joker . The series follows a young heiress named Ririchiyo Shirakiin who is fiercely protected by her bodyguard and eventual love interest, Soshi Miketsukami. The anime spun a tale of yearning that leaned into a low-fantasy world with the introduction of supernatural residents that live in the same apartment complex as Ririchiyo, as well as Soshi pining for the lead protagonist in such a devoted manner that it stretches beyond multiple timelines.

The 15th Anniversary Inu x Boku SS Art Brings The Cast Back In A Stunning New Visual

The new commemorative anime art piece features the core cast of Inu x Boku SS , with every Maison de Ayakashi resident accompanied by their respective bodyguards. With Ririchiyo and Soshi being the main centerpiece of the graphic, the visual also features Nobara Yukinokouji, Renshou Sorinozuka, Banri Watanuki, Zange Natsume, Karuta Roromiya and Kagerou Shoukiin, each holding party poppers, presents, and other party decorations while dressed in formal attire.

This isn’t where the anniversary celebration for the series ends, though, with the official website for the anime announcing that Inu x Boku SS will continue the celebration with a special re-broadcast of the series beginning in January 2027. Leading up to the re-broadcast, there will be a special stage event in Japan as part of the Kitakyushu Pop Culture Festival featuring two of the main cast members from the series: Rina Hidaka, who plays the main protagonist Ririchiyo Shirakiin, and Yoko Hikasa who plays Nobara Yukinokouji.

Inu x Boku SS Is a Beloved Supernatural Romance That Dominated The 2010s

Based on the original manga by the late Cocoa Fujiwara, Inu x Boku SS was an adorably unique romance anime that came out of the 2010’s era that captivated fans the moment it began airing. As of writing, Inu x Boku SS has over 5.1-million copies in circulation, which skyrocketed after the anime was initially being produced and steadily climbed after the series reached its end. Even later into the series’ publication, Volume 9 of Inu x Boku SS took the top slot in Oricon’s sales charts in its first week on bookstore shelves with over 200,000 copies being sold. Despite the manga’s success and the anime being beloved by fans, there’s a vocal corner of the fanbase that’s hoping the anime will someday continue.

David Production’s anime adaptation only ran for a brisk 12-episodes, adapting only the first four volumes of the 11-volume series, which ultimately left out many of the darker plot twists found in the original work. Whether in spite of or because of fans’ hopes that the anime will someday continue, Inu x Boku SS has maintained an active fanbase in Japan and overseas.

The franchise continues to host pop-up shops that feature new merchandise with the main cast and a variety of merchandise collaborations, including brand-new Nendoroid figures being planned by Goodsmile Company and exclusive 15th Anniversary merchandise being planned for fans of the anime in Japan. But can you believe it’s been 15 years of Inu x Boku SS ? Let us know in the comments.

title: Live-Action The Remarried Empress Series Drives Surge in Original Webtoon, Web Novel Readership
content:
Naver WEBTOON reported on November 19 that readership of the original The Remarried Empress webtoon and web novel surged following the premiere of its Disney+ live-action series.

According to Naver WEBTOON on November 19, global views of the original webtoon increased approximately 35-fold during the two weeks following the series' November 3 premiere (November 3–16), compared to the two weeks before the release of its preview video (August 12–25). Views of the Korean-language version increased 54-fold, while the English-language version saw a 35-fold increase. Readership also rose significantly across all other available languages.

The original web novel, available through Naver Series, recorded an approximately 45-fold increase in views over the same period.

Written by Alphatart , The Remarried Empress originally began on Naver Web Novel's Challenge League before receiving an official serialization on Naver Series. The story was later adapted into a webtoon written by HereLee and illustrated by SUMPUL , which has surpassed 3 billion cumulative views worldwide.

The live-action series follows Navier ( Min-A Shin ), empress of the fictional Eastern Empire, who is told by Emperor Sovieshu ( Ji-Hoon Ju ) that he wants a divorce. She agrees on the condition that she be allowed to remarry Prince Heinrey (Jong-suk Lee) of the neighboring Western Kingdom.

The Disney+ adaptation premiered on November 3 and quickly attracted international attention. According to Disney+ , it became the most-watched locally produced original title across Disney+ markets worldwide during its first three days of release. It ranked second globally in Disney+ TV shows on November 18, according to streaming rankings site FlixPatrol.

The webtoon ended in January after a seven-year run. The webtoon then launched side stories on October 29.

The English version of the The Remarried Empress webtoon is available on WEBTOON . Ize Press is releasing the series in print.

The webtoon also has an upcoming anime adaptation slated to debut in 2027.

title: I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game Web Novel, Webtoon Gets Mobile Game Adaptation
content:
WEBZEN, a Korean game developer and publisher, has announced it is developing a mobile strategy RPG based on the web novel and webtoon I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game . Titled I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game: Last Stage , the game is scheduled for release in 2027.

The game will feature exploration, territory management, and defensive battles. Players will also be able to use terrain and weather conditions to develop strategies during combat.

WEBZEN began recruiting beta test participants on November 19 at 10:00 a.m. KST through the game's official website. The test will be available to players in South Korea, Japan, and Taiwan on Android and iOS devices. Participants will be selected through a lottery, with the testing schedule and download details to be announced separately.

WEBZEN will also launch a dedicated website introducing the game and showcasing its adaptation of the original webtoon's characters and world.

Currently, a release plan for North American region is not yet confirmed.

RyuMo's original novel was serialized on Naver Series between 2021 and 2024. Gyong and adaptor Ha Jung's webtoon adaptation has been running since 2022.

Fans can read the official English version of the webtoon on WEBTOON and Tappytoon (the title on Tappytoon is Tyrant of the Tower Defense Game ).

title: One Piece Is About to Unravel a Mystery That Has Kept Fans Guessing for 3 Years
content:
One Piece ‘s latest chapter has begun unraveling a mystery that the series introduced over three years ago, in May 2023, and it could change much of what fans know about the series. Given that One Piece is currently in its final saga, it was evident that the series would begin unveiling the mysteries it has built up over more than 1,000 chapters. While several have been explained here and there, one of the most intriguing mysteries the series has kept concealed revolves around the Void Century. There are hundreds of speculations about what this century holds, but a few characters have been particularly connected to it.

Among the several characters tied to the Void Century , one of the most intriguing is Nefertari D. Lili, the queen of Alabasta during that era. She was one of the founding royals behind the World Government; however, she refused to become a Celestial Dragon and instead returned to her country. This has been unveiled and hinted at several times in the past, ever since King Cobra first mentioned the queen and revealed that she had also left behind a letter. The latest chapter hints that Robin may finally read this very letter, and it couldn’t have been unveiled at a more perfect time.

One Piece Is About to Unveil a Major Void Century Mystery, and the Timing Couldn’t Be More Perfect

One Piece Chapter 1195 had subtly revealed that a woman named Lili once lived in Elbaph, and now the latest chapter, 1199, unveils that what she left behind was a letter that Robin is about to read. It is now evident that this is indeed the same letter Cobra mentioned, potentially containing an important piece of information related to the Void Century. However, the timing of this revelation is also intriguing, as Luffy has mysteriously transformed into a rogue version of his Gear 5 appearance , displaying entirely monkey-like behavior and features. Perhaps the letter Robin is about to read could have something to do with this transformation.

It has been speculated that Lili was at the center of the conflict involving Imu and Joyboy, with some fans even suggesting a possible love triangle. That may very well be true, and Joyboy, as Nika, could also be connected to the form Luffy has now transformed into. One Piece still has a lot to explain about Luffy’s new appearance, and with speculation already suggesting that this is a second version of the Sun God , feared as the destroyer of the world, the series has plenty of questions to answer. The Elbaph mural also hints at this very version. With the mention of Lili and a letter that is finally about to be read, the series has raised the stakes surrounding this mystery and the answers it is about to unveil.

The Void Century remains one of the most intriguing mysteries One Piece has concealed, and even a single piece of information about it could help connect the dots and reveal what actually happened during this period. By bringing Lili’s letter into the picture alongside Luffy’s mysterious new appearance, One Piece is in the perfect position to finally unveil some of its biggest secrets. Honestly, the series couldn’t be better prepared to address these mysteries, and it should begin doing so in the next chapter without delaying any further.

title: Martial Arts Manhwa Yeolhyeol Gangho to End Next Year After 33 Years
content:
The long-running Korean martial arts manhwa Yeolhyeol Gangho , also known as The Ruler of the Land in English, is scheduled to conclude in February 2027 with its 97th collected volume, ending a serialization that began more than 30 years ago.

Story writer Geuk-jin Jeon and artist Jae-hyun Yang (56) announced the planned conclusion in an interview with YNA on Saturday. The series first launched in May 1994 in the inaugural issue of the manhwa magazine Young Champ . Originally intended to conclude around its 30th anniversary, the series was extended as the creators continued developing its characters and storylines.

Yeolhyeol Gangho follows Bi-gwang Han, a disciple of the leader of the unorthodox martial arts faction Cheonma Shingun, and Hwa-rin Dam, granddaughter of the orthodox faction's Sword Emperor. Together, they face the Shinji, a powerful organization threatening the martial arts world.

The series became known for its approach to a new generation of martial arts storytelling, moving away from some of the heavier conventions of traditional martial arts comics. As of 2023, its collected print volumes had sold more than 10 million copies, while paid digital downloads exceeded 30 million.

The decision to conclude the series was influenced partly by the creators' health. Both said that decades of continuous work had taken a physical toll, and they wanted to finish the story while they were still able to produce the work themselves. Artist Yang also revealed that he had experienced temporary paralysis in one arm during production.

Although the original series will conclude in print, the Yeolhyeol Gangho intellectual property (IP) continues to expand. Naver WEBTOON is developing Yeolhyeol Gangho Remastered , a vertical-scroll version of the original manhwa . Meanwhile, the game Yeolhyeol Gangho Online has surpassed 130 million cumulative players worldwide. Live-action series, animation projects, and new games are also in development.

The creators said they hope readers will continue returning to the collected volumes and enjoying the series long after its conclusion. Both also expressed gratitude to readers who have followed Han Bi-gwang and Dam Hwa-rin's journey for more than three decades.

An official English version of the manhwa is not available at the moment. ADV Manga had released three volumes of the series under the title The Ruler of the Land in 2004.

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Gives Frieza’s Return a Major Upgrade
content:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has officially kicked off the Resurrection F arc with its newest episode, and with it has given Frieza’s return a major upgrade compared to the original version. Dragon Ball Super has been offering up a newly enhanced take on the now classic TV anime series from over a decade ago, and the first episodes of the new series had revealed how the Battle of Gods arc had been upgraded from its original release . Now it’s time to see how it works out in the next arc.

With the previous episode of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus wrapping up its take on the Battle of Gods arc as Goku and Beerus’ fight had come to its end , the new remake series can now move forward with the next arc. Resurrection F had been one of the more divisive arcs from the original film and TV versions seen before, and this new remake offers a chance to make up from those previous missteps. And that seems to be heading in a promising direction already.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 7 Amps Up Frieza’s Resurrection

Following the post-credits scene at the end of the previous episode , the Resurrection F start has now begun as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus sees Sorbet and the rest of the surviving Frieza Force scouring the universe for the Dragon Balls. Coming to Earth, they are able to successfully wish to revive the villain thanks to Emperor Pilaf and his gang collecting the balls to make their own wish. And by the end of the episode, Frieza has come back to life. Which already makes it feel speedier than before.

The original version of the Resurrection F arc in Dragon Ball Super ‘s TV series only ran for 9 episodes compared to the 18 seen with the Battle of Gods arc, so it does raise some questions as to how long the arc is going to last for in the remake. With Battle of Gods wrapping up its own events within six episodes, the new version might end up moving through Frieza’s return even quicker than that. But the overall episode count of the new series has yet to be confirmed as of this time .

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been confirmed to share new versions of the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F and Universe 6 sagas before it comes to an end. It’s likely going to continue through the rest of the Fall 2026 slate, and end sometime in January or February by the time it gets through all three arcs. With the three arcs spanning nearly 50 episodes during their initial run, and 19 episodes for the Universe 6 arcs, ending sometime during the Winter 2027 broadcast schedule does make a lot of sense .

There are still the Goku Black and Universe Survival Sagas left on the table for a potential remake of this kind, but nothing of the sort has been revealed to be in the works at this time. With Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol also now in the works as it plans to adapt one of the future arcs only seen in the manga , there could be a lot more Dragon Ball Super anime on the way than fans might realize.

What are you hoping to see in this new take on Frieza’s return in Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ? How have you liked the reboot so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.
